event_summary: Two hands lower a parallel-wire slicer frame onto a white food piece in a tabletop slicer, leaving the food visibly divided by parallel cuts.
raw_event_description: A white tabletop slicer sits on a wooden surface with a rounded white food piece positioned in its circular slotted cradle. A shiny metal frame containing many parallel wires and a blue handle is held above the food at an angle. The right hand moves the blue-handled wire frame downward while the left hand steadies the base. As the frame descends, the parallel wires cross the food piece, and parallel cut lines appear across its visible surface. By the end, the frame is much lower over the base, and the food shows multiple adjacent thin sections while a short smooth white end portion remains visible on the right.

reasons: The slicer, wire frame, food piece, and both hands are visible.
The wire frame is already positioned above the food and appears ready to descend.
Some edges of the base and frame are partly covered by hands.
